run_versiongenerate: run the script to extract version info from configure.ac and generate Version.h
extract_version_from_configure_ac: extract the major minor and fix version numbers from a configure.ac file using regex
generate_version_header: generate a Version.h header file with GTEST_VERSIONINFO_SHORT and GTEST_VERSIONINFO_LONG defines
parse_ac_init_macro: parse the AC_INIT macro in configure.ac to extract bracketed version strings
review_versiongenerate_script: review the versiongenerate.py script that prepares version info for gtest Info.plist
